prerequisites: Completion of the study entry and orientation phase

learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to apply the acquired knowledge and their competencies in sub-fields of biomedical engineering to correctly solve practical problems in the respective area.
Students are familiar with the necessary theoretical foundations, methods, and theories and know their application possibilities and limitations.
Students are able to adequately document and discuss elaborated results and solutions.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of physical and electrochemical transduction principles
Interface of biological tissue and technical system
Medical sensors and microsensors (gas sensors, temperature sensors, MOS-FET as ion-sensitive FET, enzyme-FET)
Electrical and electronic actuators (active implants, defibrillators)
Possibilities of preprocessing medical image data (edge filters, smoothing filters)
Introduction to fundamental methods for segmenting medical image data (thresholding, region-based methods)
Introduction to methods for visualizing three-dimensional structures (Marching Cubes method, Raycasting)
